validation.slug: Use 3–80 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens

settings.title: Agency settings
settings.description: The details that keep your rental business running.
settings.setupDescription: Set your business details, add pickup locations and define your rental policies.
settings.accessDenied: You don’t have access to these settings.
settings.readOnly: You can view these details. An agency owner or administrator can change them.
settings.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?
settings.identityHint: Your agency’s name and contact information.
settings.regionalHint: Branches keep their own timezone. Currency changes apply to newly published policies.
settings.name: Agency name
settings.localeHint: Used for future agency content. Your personal interface language stays unchanged.
settings.codeHint: A unique code for your team, such as CASA-01.
settings.branchHint: Pickup locations, local opening hours and contact details.
settings.noBranches: Your first pickup location starts here.
settings.archiveConfirm: Archive this branch? It will leave the active list. Its history will be kept.
settings.hoursHint: Local branch time. Add up to two intervals per day; use the next day for hours after midnight. 24:00 means the end of the day.
settings.closureHint: Up to 32 dates when this branch is closed all day.
settings.policyHint: Each publication keeps an immutable copy of your terms. Earlier versions remain available.
settings.publishHint: Publishes immediately. Draft values are suggestions; review every field before publishing.
settings.depositHint: Enter the amount in this currency, for example 2500.00. Set 0 for no deposit.
settings.termsHint: Include rental, cancellation, mileage, fuel and deposit terms. At least one language is required; 8,000 characters per language.
settings.configurationOnly: These settings prepare your agency for future bookings. They do not collect payments or create reservations.
settings.noTranslation: No text provided in this language.
settings.currencyChanged: The agency currency changed. Review the deposit amount before publishing a new version.

validation.name: Use 2–160 characters.
validation.hours: Use HH:mm with opening before closing. Intervals must not overlap.
validation.number: Enter a whole number within the indicated range.
validation.amount: Enter a valid amount within the indicated range.
validation.terms: Add policy text in at least one language.

errors.generic: Couldn’t save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.conflict: Someone changed this information. Load the latest version, then apply your changes again.
errors.code: This code is already used, including by archived branches.
errors.limit: This agency has reached the limit of 100 branches, including archived locations.
errors.denied: You no longer have permission to change this information.
errors.invalid: Review the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.archived: This branch was archived. Load the latest version.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.description: Your vehicles, organized for the road.
fleet.denied: You do not have access to this fleet.
fleet.archiveConfirm: Archive this vehicle? It will be hidden from public use. Its records and photos will be preserved.
fleet.restoreHint: Restore its branch and category before restoring this vehicle.
fleet.emptyHint: Create a branch and category, then add your first vehicle.
fleet.exact: Exact fleet number, plate or VIN
fleet.visibilityHint: Controls whether this vehicle can appear in the future public catalog. This is not a booking availability status.
fleet.conflict: This record changed. Your draft is kept. Load the latest version before saving again.
fleet.invalid: Check the value and its allowed length or range.
fleet.failed: The change could not be saved. Check your access and try again.
fleet.duplicate: That code, fleet number, plate or VIN is already used in this agency.
fleet.reference: Choose an active branch, category and features from this agency.
fleet.limit: The agency limit has been reached.
fleet.archivedError: Restore this record before editing it.
fleet.catalogHint: Codes stay reserved after archival. Existing vehicle references are preserved.
fleet.requiredSetup: Add an active branch and category before creating a vehicle.
fleet.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 3 MiB each. Up to 12 photos. Images are processed without location metadata; uploaded photos may be shared publicly.
fleet.photoInvalid: Use a valid single-frame JPEG, PNG or WebP under 3 MiB and 24 megapixels.
fleet.uploadLimit: Photo, upload rate or storage limit reached. Remove a photo or try again later.
fleet.noPhotos: Add a clear exterior photo to identify this vehicle.
fleet.costHint: Private purchase amount in {currency}. Leave blank to clear. No accounting entry is created.
fleet.photoAltRequired: Add a photo description in at least one language.

operations.title: Vehicle operations
operations.description: Readiness, service, inspections and follow-up work in one operational view.
operations.vehicleOperationsHint: Mileage, compliance and the work that determines whether this vehicle is ready.
operations.denied: You do not have access to this operational area.
operations.evidenceHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF up to 3 MiB. The app stores fresh readable images; PDF signatures, forms, attachments and searchable text are not preserved.
operations.uploadFailed: The evidence could not be processed. Your document draft was kept.
operations.empty: Nothing needs attention in this view.
operations.failed: The change could not be saved. Check your access and try again.
operations.conflict: This record changed. Load the latest version before saving again.
operations.invalid: Review the required values and time range.
operations.acknowledgment: I confirm this inspection reflects the vehicle condition observed by staff.
operations.setupHint: Configure only the requirements your agency has explicitly adopted.
operations.name: Name
operations.scheduleHint: Track the next service by date, distance or whichever comes first.
operations.intervalHint: Set at least one interval. When both are set, either threshold can make the service due.
operations.intervalInvalid: Enter a service name and a positive distance or a whole number of days from 1 to 3650.
operations.baselineHint: Link this schedule to maintenance and complete the work to establish a service baseline. Distance intervals also require a mileage observation.
operations.archiveHint: Archive this service schedule? Its automatic reminder task will close and its service history will remain available.
operations.scheduleHasWork: Complete or cancel the unfinished maintenance linked to this schedule before archiving it.
operations.scheduleLimit: The operation limit was reached. Archive an unused schedule or reduce unfinished work before trying again.
operations.selectVehicle: Choose a vehicle to view its service schedules.
operations.linkedSchedulesHint: Completion resets only the selected schedules.
operations.noActiveSchedules: No active service schedules for this vehicle.
operations.correctionHint: Append a corrected observation with a reason. The original remains in the history and its observation time stays unchanged.
operations.replacementHint: Record the vehicle’s lifetime distance and the new instrument’s reading. Future readings use this baseline; replacing an instrument does not reset lifetime distance.
operations.mileageConflict: The reading must fit the surrounding lifetime-distance observations. Review the values and try again.
operations.dateConflict: A mileage observation already exists at this exact time. Choose a later observed time for the replacement.
operations.odometerConflict: This instrument baseline has later readings. Review the current mileage history before correcting it.
operations.costCorrectionHint: Record a replacement total with a reason. The original cost and any reversing entries stay in the history.
operations.emergencyHint: Report work needed now. This blocks readiness immediately and keeps existing scheduled work for staff to resolve.
operations.plannedWorkHint: Planned downtime uses a finite time range. Emergency work does not need an estimated end.
operations.amendmentHint: Create a linked draft to correct this completed inspection. Its locked evidence stays available.
operations.availabilityHint: Record finite downtime and manual holds. Resolve automatic issues in their source record.
operations.downtimeConflict: This period overlaps an existing allocation. Adjust the dates and try again.
operations.amendmentExists: A linked amendment already exists. Open it to continue.
operations.templateVersionHint: Saving changes creates a new version. Existing inspections retain their original checklist.
operations.archiveCatalogHint: Archive this entry? It remains available in historical records.
operations.catalogLimit: This catalog has reached its active entry limit. Archive an entry before adding another.
operations.catalogCodeTaken: This code already exists. Choose a unique code.
operations.assigneeUnavailable: This assignee is no longer an active member. Choose another member.
operations.cancellationReasonRequired: Enter the cancellation reason in findings before cancelling.
